2. The disputed plot No. 1025 measuring an area of 1.25 acres of appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 36 originally belonged to Bhuk-ailas Raj State and after acquisition it was recorded in the Khas Khatian of the Government as bhiti land. 

 4. The case of the defendant is that in the recent settlement operation the suit land was recorded in the khas khatian of the Government as a bhiti land with a note in the remark column, “সাধারণের ব্যবহার্য” but through mistake the word “শ্বশান” was not recorded. 

 8. In the present case the lower appellate court found that the S.A. Khatian with respect to the Suit land was erroneous. This finding is a question of fact and it has not been urged that it has been arrived at by misreading of evidence. The plaintiff alleged that the suit land changed its character. P.W. 8 himself admitted that the local Hindus used to burn dead bodies in the suit land some 7/8 years ago, i.e., long after the preparation of the S.A. Khatian. Chapter III of the Government Estates Manual, 1958 gives a detailed description of the Register that arc to be maintained.
